events.title: Invitation for Amicus Curiae in Bowe v. United States
events.summary: The Supreme Court issued an order in the pending case of Bowe v. United States (Docket No. 24-5438), inviting Kasdin M. Mitchell, Esquire, of Dallas, Texas, to brief and argue the case as amicus curiae. The invitation is specifically to support the judgment below concerning Question 1 presented by the petition for a writ of certiorari. This procedural step allows for additional legal perspectives to be considered by the Court.
events.why_relevant: The invitation for amicus curiae participation can influence the Court's understanding and ruling on significant legal questions.

events.title: Supreme Court releases opinion in Hungary v. Simon (23-867)
events.summary: The Supreme Court released an official slip opinion in Hungary v. Simon. Docket number(s): 23-867.
events.why_relevant: The Supreme Court's official opinion in Hungary v. Simon is a primary legal source. Supreme Court opinions can define binding national law and alter the legal position of the executive branch, federal agencies, states, litigants, and democratic institutions.
